listings.name: Macsteel VRN
listings.current_description: Macsteel VRN is Macsteel's speciality processing division in Superbia, supplying and processing speciality carbon steel plate, stainless steel and aluminium grades -- including wear-resistant, high-strength, pressure-vessel and marine grades -- with in-house flame, plasma and laser cutting, guillotining, rolling, bending and CNC machining, backed by an in-house metallurgical testing laboratory.

listings.name: Netcare Pholoso Hospital
listings.address: Cnr Grobler Street & Eland Avenue, Fauna Park, 0699
listings.current_description: Netcare Pholoso Hospital is a 200-bed private hospital in Fauna Park offering specialist services including a maternity unit with a neonatal intensive care unit, a paediatric ward, and a 24-hour emergency unit with a helicopter landing pad, alongside surgical and medical specialties such as cardiology, orthopaedic surgery and general surgery.

listings.name: Bennie Boekwurm Pre-school
listings.current_description: Bennie Boekwurm Pre-school is a registered nursery school and aftercare centre in Ladanna that also runs a dedicated homework centre, helping learners complete homework accurately alongside standard aftercare supervision. It offers transport, extramural activities and holiday care on a large outdoor play area, with staff trained in advanced pre-school first aid.

listings.name: Kurumba Lodge
listings.current_description: Kurumba Lodge is a guest house and conference venue in Hospital Park offering en-suite bedrooms alongside presidential, exclusive and honeymoon suites, plus a self-catering unit set in a manicured garden with a private braai area; it also has an on-site restaurant and conference rooms that can host functions and small weddings.

listings.name: Girasole Energy
listings.current_description: Girasole Energy is a Polokwane solar supplier and installer, established in 2015 and grown out of an electrical motor rewinding and generator maintenance business with over 50 years' history; it supplies and installs solar panels, batteries and inverters, manufactures solar panel framework, and is an official partner of Gauteng-based S&P Power Units.

listings.name: Marlot Guest House
listings.current_description: Marlot Guest House is a Hospital Park guest house with air-conditioned single, double and family rooms set in a manicured garden, each with a private entrance and en-suite bathroom; guests can also use an outdoor pool, sun terrace and games room, with a restaurant serving African cuisine and a bar on site.

listings.name: Forty 4 on Hoog
listings.current_description: Forty 4 on Hoog is a 4-star, adults-only guest house set around an outdoor swimming pool and garden, with suites ranging from Junior Suites to a King Deluxe Suite with fireplace and a Presidential Suite with a kitchenette. Guests get a full English or Irish breakfast, free WiFi, private parking and full-day security.
